findings.evidence: check-sources.mjs download() writes optional raw bodies only if SOURCE_REVIEW_RAW_DIRECTORY is set; extractSourceText() can then throw before returning status/url/type/bytes/hash. worker() writes source-evidence JSON only on success; its catch receives no transportEvidence for the extraction error. The hosted workflow leaves RAW_DIRECTORY unset.
findings.consequence: The four original hosted results preserve only the unreadable error/dependencies/fetch time. Their missing response bodies cannot be reconstructed from later successful fetches.

findings.consequence: No selector/length-threshold relaxation, arbitrary hydration extraction or new shell heuristic is justified by this evidence.

findings.finding: Follow-up transport differs from hosted transport

findings.consequence: The follow-up confirms only those separate responses. All four original hosted causes remain unclassified.

boundedImplementationProposal.owner: root; proposal only, not implemented by this audit
captureWithoutRefetch: In download(), wrap parsing/extraction and attach status, final/requested URLs, content type, decoded-body byte count, raw SHA256, route/retrieval method and normalization version from the already-received response to extraction errors.

Attach bounded diagnostics such as title, script count, access-interstitial result, candidate selector/text lengths and supporting-passage presence. Do not log cookies, authentication headers or secrets; these are public-source responses.
In worker() catch, write the failed source-evidence/<id>.json as well as the existing result/queue observation, preserving original failure kind and timestamps.
Do not replace a good baseline, auto-resolve review items, advance substantive review dates or weaken minimum substantive-content/interstitial checks when extraction fails.
boundedReproduction: After review, run only the four named sources in the ordinary hosted environment, preserving the original run artifacts.

Enable SOURCE_REVIEW_RAW_DIRECTORY for that bounded run under the existing HTML/PDF caps so its exact received body is available even if extraction fails; capture the failure JSON independently of that environment variable.
Stop after the bounded observation; do not cycle around an access/security response. Use retained exact body and candidate diagnostics to determine whether response content or extraction is at fault.
meaningfulTests: A successful-HTTP empty body and a JS-only shell should retain failure metadata/evidence, keep fetch-failed and leave the prior baseline/review date intact.
A real substantive page with a generic noscript JavaScript notice should continue to extract actual main content and match its passage.
An extraction exception after successful transport should save a bounded diagnostic without performing a second network request.
